caption_L2L3: This graph strongly suggests that Amazon has the lions share in site visits (at slightly over 0.10). The closest competitor to Amazon is eBay with a market share of visit at around 0.7. Overall, one striking pattern is that the shopping and classifieds market is dominated by three players: Amazon, eBay and Craigslist.
